description: The cubicle.script catalogue, read from the runner: every function with its signature, what it returns and its Pine equivalent (ta.ema for ema; high(n) is ta.highest(high, n)[1], the bars before this one), the series, built-ins and truths a gate can read, the order kinds, where an order can fill, the fill models, the draw kinds, the timeframes and the budget. Pass `name` to keep only the names that contain it. Free.

name.description: keep only the entries whose name (or Pine name) contains this, such as atr or ta.rsi

name: script_catalogue
